summary: Repaired the stale canonical output-schema binding so the support agent declaration now matches the schema passed directly to Cloudflare AIChatAgent structured output.
observations: Before the change, project validation reported the sole diagnostic CLOUDFLARE_AGENTS_AGENT_OUTPUT_SCHEMA_NOT_WIRED.
Repository source passes SupportOutputSchema to Output.object in src/agent.ts; the canonical binding incorrectly referenced LegacySupportOutputSchema.
Changed only the canonical outputSchema symbol from LegacySupportOutputSchema to SupportOutputSchema.
Complete project validation passed with valid=true and diagnosticCount=0 using repository-local moldea CLI 7.0.1/schema 4.
Final Git diff contains exactly the intended one-line binding change, and Git status lists only moldea/moldea.yaml as modified.
